title: The Characteristics of a Helping Relationship
coreMove: Test a relationship by what it makes speakable for the other person, not by how supportive you feel.
sourcePressure: The chapter turns the growth conditions into the actual shape of a relationship that reduces defensiveness and makes truth easier to say. Frozen sidecar ch03 supports the heading, part placement, and broad thematic claims; it exposes no chapter-local named anecdotes, studies, or places.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Assuming comfort, warmth, or friendliness proves the relationship is helping.
sourceAnchorNote: The frozen source exposes no usable chapter-local named person, study, institution, place, date, or anecdotal artifact from Rogers here. Use fictional protagonists only; do not invent named Rogers cases or studies.

hook: opening with a definition of helping relationship
counterintuition: Most people think X, but Y
It is not about being nice
The paradox is that acceptance changes everything
